units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:5:22">Y. Taan. IV, 69ᵇ</cite> <he>לא נראה עיף טָס וכ׳</he> no bird has been seen flying in all Palestine; Lam. R. introd. end.—
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 6">Deut. R. s. 6</cite> <he>קושט … וטס כעוף</he> goes straight like an arrow, and swift like a bird.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 90:9">Midr. Till. to Ps. XC, 10</cite> <he>גזין חשין וטָסִין</he> they pass, hasten and fly; a. fr.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:7">Koh. R. to IX, 7</cite> <he>ט׳ וחזר וט׳</he> he flew to and back.

senses.gloss: to cause to fly, to bring on by flight.
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 7:7">Ruth R. to IV, 1</cite> <he>הטִיסוֹ וכ׳</he> the Lord would have made him fly and brought him (to the place).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:9:4">Cant. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>הֵטִיסָן</he>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 23:1">Ex. R. s. 23</cite> end <he>הסיטן</he> (corr. acc.).—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:1">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>הסיט׳</he>, (read as) <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 232">Yalk. Kings 232</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11">Lev. R. s. 11</cite>, beg. <he>הסיטן</he> (corr. acc.) he winged them; a. fr.
